title: [spec-gap][R-SCHC-018] constants.toml [schc.fragment] lacks tile_size; spec appendix cites it as source of TILE_SIZE=179
description: Spec-coverage sweep of spec/appendix-schc.md (R-SCHC-018, docs/spec-coverage/appendix-schc.md, flagged F2). Values are correct in all three stacks: Rust TILE_SIZE=(185*8-15-32)/8=179 (rust/lichen-schc/src/fragment.rs:28-29), Python fragment.py:37, C SCHC_FRAGMENT_TILE_SIZE 179u (lichen/subsys/schc/include/schc/schc.h:125) with _Static_assert in lichen/tests/schc_fragment_generation/main.c:205. DIVERGENT REFERENCE: spec/appendix-schc.md lines 8 and 56 cite 'constants.toml [schc.fragment]' as the source of TILE_SIZE=179, but [schc.fragment] (constants.toml:64-74) has m/n/t/window_size/rcs_bytes/retransmission_timeout_s/max_ack_requests/inactivity_timeout_s/bitmap_msb_first and NO tile_size key. Suggested placement: either add tile_size = 179 to constants.toml [schc.fragment] (making the citation true; note Rust/Python derive it, so keep the C static-assert as anti-drift), or amend spec lines 8/56 to drop the constants.toml attribution for TILE_SIZE.
